gaps.GET /v1/rules/resource/approval-rules: lists the governed core's approval rules for model, connector and A2A calls (the ADR-0226 list contract)
gaps.GET /v1/rules/resource/approval-rules/ex: the approval-rule list as an Excel file (the ADR-0226 list contract, audited)
gaps.GET /v1/rules/resource/rate-limits: lists the governed core's rate limits for connector and A2A calls (the ADR-0226 list contract)
gaps.GET /v1/rules/resource/rate-limits/expor: the rate-limit list as an Excel file (the ADR-0226 list contract, audited)
gaps.POST /v1/rules/resource/approval-rules: adds an approval rule for model, connector or A2A calls (audited)
gaps.PATCH /v1/rules/resource/approval-rules/: changes a rule's approver or writeOnly (a loosening is a settings_relax step-up, audited)
gaps.DELETE /v1/rules/resource/approval-rules: removes an approval rule (settings_relax step-up, audited)
gaps.POST /v1/rules/resource/rate-limits: adds a rate limit for connector or A2A calls (audited)
gaps.PATCH /v1/rules/resource/rate-limits/:ru: changes a limit's calls or window (a loosening is a settings_relax step-up, audited)
gaps.DELETE /v1/rules/resource/rate-limits/:r: removes a rate limit (settings_relax step-up, audited)
